Ferry notices

The crossing charts are in the chart folder for the winter crews.

The berth list is in the berth folder. Moorings are checked each morning before the first sailing leaves the slip.
The fuel log is in the fuel folder.
Deck crews sign the log at the end of each shift on the quay.

The rota is in the rota folder for the deck crews.

The timetable is on the ferry office page, and printed copies are at the ticket hall.

The harbour plan is on the plan page for visitors.
